params.body:
## What

Two new kinds, judged and performed by the gateway, so a pull request can be put on a project's preview site without any write credential on the operator's laptop:

- `preview.push` on `owner/repo`: set the branch literally named `preview` to a commit (`params.sha`, full id; `params.pull`, `params.head` for the record). Forced update, since pull request heads share no history; the previous head goes into the record. Created when the branch does not exist yet. Under the App's credential (or the owner token fallback), like every GitHub effect.
- `forge.deploy` on `forge:<slug>`: call the preview site's tokenless Forge deployment trigger URL, held in the secrets as `forge-deploy-<slug>` (the URL is the secret). The URL never appears in an outcome or a record, not even on failure; a secret that does not point under `https://forge.laravel.com/` is refused unread.

## Policy (`policy.previewRule`, deterministic over action and path)

- `preview.push` sets the branch named `preview` and no other (held again in the adapter);
- a second `preview.push` in one run is a DENY whatever `max_per_kind` says;
- `forge.deploy` before a `preview.push` in the same run is a DENY;
- both need the grant and the capability like `branch.push` does (kind and resource in both).

New schema type `hex40` (a full git commit id): a short id would let the far end resolve it.

## Deploy

- `deploy/gcp/startup.sh` derives `control-forge-deploy-<slug>` from every `forge:<slug>` resource in the carried grants, like `portal-token` from `portal:`.
- `deploy/gcp/rehearse.sh tokens` also carries `forge-deploy-*` files from the box's `elixir-secrets/control/`.
- `docs/preview.md`: the kinds, the rule, and the operator's steps.

## Tests

`go test ./...` green: policy rule (other branch, deploy first, second push, short sha), GitHub adapter (forced when the branch exists, made when not, refused before GitHub for another branch or a short sha), Forge adapter (trigger from the secret, URL out of every outcome, secret outside the base refused unread, Forge's refusal as the outcome), and the service end to end (one run of two steps, refusals recorded with the far ends untouched, the secret absent from answer and records). `cmd/verify` has no kind list and is unaffected.

## Release: v0.26.0

After merging, the owner:

1. Tags `v0.26.0`; the workflow builds the assets.
2. Pins the sha256 of `control-gateway-linux-amd64` from `SHA256SUMS` in `deploy/gcp/startup.sh` (a PR, "The VM on v0.26.0").
3. On Forge: sets the preview site's branch to `preview`, quick deploy off, copies its Deployment Trigger URL.
4. On the box as `elixir`: writes that URL as one line to `/home/elixir/elixir-secrets/control/forge-deploy-stocklistplatform-eu` (0600).
5. From the Mac: `deploy/gcp/rehearse.sh tokens` (creates `control-forge-deploy-stocklistplatform-eu`); `gcloud secrets versions list control-forge-deploy-stocklistplatform-eu` must show a version.
6. Once elixir's `Workbench` grant names the kinds and `forge:stocklistplatform-eu` (abovebeyond-ai/elixir, companion PR): `scp elixir@167.233.221.164:control/config.json ~/control-config.json && deploy/gcp/rehearse.sh config ~/control-config.json`.
7. `deploy/gcp/rehearse.sh upgrade`.

Companion PRs: elixir (grant), portal (`WORKBENCH_KINDS` and the `forge:` resource in the capability), the platform repo (docs, the laptop script removed), and `hand.mjs preview` on the Mac.
params.title: A pull request on the preview through the gateway: preview.push and forge.deploy (v0.26.0)
